verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Incident Workflows deliver exactly this: condition-based 'if-this-then-that' automation triggered by incident events (e.g., auto-trigger on P1/P2), with actions like status updates, reminders, and field changes, plus AI Orchestrations to auto-generate rules. Escalation policies and event orchestration further automate toil around alert handling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of workflow reliability at scale, and more detail on the breadth of available workflow actions beyond examples given.
